The diagram shows the graph of the probability density function, $\text{f}$, of a random variable $X$, where $a$ is a constant greater than 0.5. The graph between $x = 0$ and $x = a$ is a straight line parallel to the $x$-axis.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A random variable $T$ has probability density function given by

$$\text{g}(t) = \begin{cases} \frac{3}{2(t-1)^2} & 2 \leqslant t \leqslant 4, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise.} \end{cases}$$

Find the value of $b$ such that $\text{P}(T \leqslant b) = \frac{3}{4}$.
